[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["buck2-tools/archive-tool","buck2-tools/core"]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0"

# Request templates are inherited only where the member semantics match.
# Each member still owns whether, where, and with which dependency kind it uses
# the request. Package-local requests remain explicit exceptions.
[workspace.dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["raw_value"] }
ryu-js = "1.0.3"
borsh = { version = "1.5", features = ["derive"] }
chrono = { version = "0.4.32", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
serde_path_to_error = "0.1"
schemars = "1"
regex = { version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["std", "unicode"] }
regex-syntax = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["std", "unicode"] }
syn = { version = "2", features = ["full"] }
quote = "1"
proc-macro2 = "1"
js-sys = "=0.3.104"
wasm-bindgen-futures = "=0.4.77"
sha2 = "0.11"
tempfile = "3"
# Exact match with the hub's wasm-bindgen-cli toolchain.
wasm-bindgen = "=0.2.127"
# Dynamic host-symbol lookup also permits standalone Rust test executables.
napi = { version = "=3.13.0", default-features = false, features = ["napi4", "dyn-symbols"] }
napi-derive = "=3.6.9"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "thin"
strip = "symbols"
# Node-API converts panics at the FFI boundary; abort would bypass reclamation.
panic = "unwind"
